mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_USER_M ( USER_ID, USER_NM, PPCD, RG_SCCD, HOLD_SCCD, RELTN_SCTN_NM, ATTY_CFY, RMK, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{USER_ID}, #{USER_NM}, #{PPCD}, #{RG_SCCD}, #{HOLD_SCCD}, #{RELTN_SCTN_NM}, #{ATTY_CFY}, #{RMK}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )

mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, USER_NM, PPCD, RG_SCCD, HOLD_SCCD, RELTN_SCTN_NM, ATTY_CFY, RMK, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_USER_M WHERE USER_ID = #{USER_ID}
